findings.title: Verify 字源 scan finding for 4E00
findings.details: [SCAN VERIFICATION REQUIRED] 字源 2012 edition, PDF p. 13, printed page unnumbered/not identified in supplied scan: the doubled/rare forms in “一”或“弌”及其比较形式 for 二 and 三 are visually not all distinct enough to assign separate Unicode identities confidently. Do not normalize or quote guessed forms; source-bound glyph/image identification needs review if those exact spellings are material.
findings.verification: Check the identified printed page and exact scan span; correct source-bound OCR or record an unresolved glyph identity.
